Next-Phase Data Adaptability Roadmap:
• Add BTS/MRT Turnstile Tap-In Telemetry -> Directly validate passenger transit shift volumes.
• Add GPS Coordinates to DDS Flood Sensors -> Enable point-to-camera flood/congestion causality beyond road-name joins.
• Capture 1-Minute Video / Optical Flow Speed -> Measure true queue delay & capacity drop alongside frame vehicle counts.
